facts.fact: Starlink has sold a Business Priority plan at N159,000 a month in Lagos, Abuja and Port Harcourt since 14 February 2026, while residential sign-ups in prime Lagos districts stay on a waitlist.

The NCC licensed Amazon Kuiper Nigeria Limited as an ISP, effective 1 January 2026, per its licensing database as reported by Legit.ng; Amazon's Project Kuiper is also said to have secured landing rights in January 2026.
A pricing dispute with the NCC halted new Starlink residential orders nationwide for eight months, November 2024 to June 2025.

systems.platform: LEO satellite broadband, licensed, not yet on sale
